results.headline: Tesla Q3 Deliveries Beat Expectations at 462,890 Vehicles
results.body: Tesla delivered 462,890 vehicles in Q3 2024, beating analyst consensus of 458,000. The beat was driven by strong Model Y demand in China and price reductions in the US market. The company maintained its full-year delivery guidance of 1.8 million vehicles.

results.headline: Tesla Robotaxi Event Reveals Cybercab; Analysts Split on Timeline
results.body: Tesla unveiled its long-awaited robotaxi, the Cybercab, at a Hollywood event. The two-seater autonomous vehicle is priced under $30,000 and is expected to enter production in 2026. Analysts expressed optimism about the long-term vision but concerns about regulatory approvals and production timelines.

answer:
Tesla's Q3 2024 deliveries exceeded expectations, reaching 462,890 vehicles compared to the analyst consensus of 458,000 [Source: news-tsla-001]. This success was attributed to strong demand for the Model Y in China and price reductions in the US market. The company has maintained its full-year delivery guidance at 1.8 million vehicles.

Tesla recently unveiled its Cybercab robotaxi at a Hollywood event, with an expected production start in 2026 [Source: news-tsla-002]. While analysts are optimistic about Tesla's long-term vision, concerns remain regarding regulatory approvals and production timelines.
